decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese wheel, it is very close to the firm's existing dairy know-how and its survival beyond the first launch year suggests the firm could absorb market feedback and refine it within its core capabilities.

Spicy cheese is still an incremental extension of the firm's established cheese competence, and although the flavor positioning is somewhat narrower, its continued presence after launch indicates enough learning and fit to justify keeping it.

A mild creamy soft cheese builds directly on the firm's related knowledge in cheese-making and the fact that it received its own product page after launch points to adequate commercial traction and scope for further improvement.
